answer: Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the karst beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Rotation is recorded in the falcon index and the river audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 88 keys live and online for the whole period, which means the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 40 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
